test-design.name: Test case design
test-design.description: Derive cases using boundaries, equivalence classes, state transitions, and business rules.

exploratory-testing.name: Exploratory testing
exploratory-testing.description: Investigate application behavior through focused sessions and reproducible observations.

defect-management.name: Defect management
defect-management.description: Document reproducible defects with expected behavior, evidence, severity, and verification results.

api-testing.name: API testing
api-testing.description: Verify endpoint contracts, authentication, validation, failure responses, and integration behavior.

regression-testing.name: Regression testing
regression-testing.description: Maintain coverage that detects unintended changes to established application behavior.

test-data-management.name: Test data management
test-data-management.description: Prepare repeatable test datasets while controlling privacy, isolation, and cleanup.

accessibility-testing.name: Accessibility testing
accessibility-testing.description: Evaluate keyboard use, assistive technologies, semantics, and interface accessibility barriers.

security-testing.name: Application security testing
security-testing.description: Test access boundaries, input handling, sessions, and known vulnerability classes.

test-strategy.name: Test strategy
test-strategy.description: Choose coverage, environments, automation scope, and release criteria based on product risk.

test-automation-architecture.name: Test automation architecture
test-automation-architecture.description: Design maintainable automation with stable fixtures, reusable interfaces, and reliable execution.

quality-metrics.name: Quality metrics
quality-metrics.description: Measure defect trends, test reliability, escaped issues, and release quality signals.
